answer: Each identity escrows bonded collateral, so splitting stake cannot erase accountability. If k identities coordinate equivocation, pairwise evidence creates O(k^2) culpable links and slashing debits their escrows. Asymmetric depreciation slows capital recovery; detection compounds swarm losses by an exponential multiplier, making sybil control costlier than its voting-power gain. A nadir in participation, comet-like influx, or delta threshold changes neither liability nor rule.
